hypothesis: A conditional path distribution and inventory-aware fixed-continuation controller can be implemented with causal training and separately verified constraints. Predictive or economic superiority is not assumed.
registered_data: Existing archived2025 AAPL MSFT BTC/USD ETH/USD with archived corporate action query for both equity names; no new provider data
forecast: Mahalanobis analogues, fixed25percent covariance shrinkage,40neighbors, minimum20calendar-compatible original cases, effective support>=10, 16context features
fixed_settings: Settings defaults committed with sources; hourly path72h, stop2percent, target3percent, costs nominal and2x plus0.5percent adverse future price gap; assumed stress set not a calibrated confidence region
historical_query: 2025-10-15 at12:00 America/New_York, flat hypothetical20000USD state and hypothetical held2lots AAPL state; quotes and liquidity modeled from archived bars; not broker observations

chronological_evaluation.purge: label known and label end strictly before test decision
chronological_evaluation.comparator: uniform probabilities on same selected original analogues
chronological_evaluation.metric: Brier identification lower/upper bounds, not confidence bounds

adaptation: No coefficient/threshold tuning after measurement. Engineering failures retained and corrected with reason; no failed count relabeled successful.
budget: One forecast recipe, one registered finite controller action grid, three fixed stress scenarios. No economic strategy search or broker experiment.
